_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic strip panel, black brush-pen ink line with muddy early-2000s digital flat colors, rubbery kinetic linework, mid-2000s webcomic look, limited palette, slightly misregistered fills. a sheet of small crude stick figures drawn in ballpoint: a crowd of them at the back of a panel holding tiny signs, two sitting on a bed, one typing at a tiny keyboard, thirty arranged like wallpaper; and separately the meme figure: a stick figure with a four-line helicopter rotor scribbled on its head hovering six inches above nothing; labeled THE CHORUS and ROLFCOPTR. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, painterly, glossy, watermark, extra fingers
